backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use the same exp-20260510-028 augmented snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260511-105 policy semantics.

before_variant.description: accepted exp-20260511-105 semantics: Space breakouts keep the generic 1.5 ATR stop

best_variant.description: only official Space breakout_long signals use a 2.0 ATR stop; targets, risk scalars, trend targets, and entries stay fixed

decision_rationale: Wider official Space breakout stops did not beat the accepted exp-105 Space stack under the three-window gate. Space breakout fragility is not solved by simply giving breakouts more stop room.

gate_questions.acceptance_standard: Must improve aggregate EV and PnL versus exp-105, improve EV in at least two windows with no EV regression, keep max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, and survival >= 5%.
gate_questions.alpha_hypothesis: Exit/risk allocation: widen only the official Space breakout initial stop while keeping Space trend target, risk, pool, and ranking locked.
prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260511-015 rejected simple Space breakout entry-to-stop risk-distance caps.
exp-20260511-022 rejected applying the PL/BKSY breakout haircut to non-data-vendor breakouts.
exp-20260511-028 rejected a separate RKLB/ASTS breakout risk scalar.
exp-20260511-037 rejected wider official Space breakout targets.
No prior Space run isolated breakout stop ATR width itself.
gate_questions.reproducibility: This script reruns core, accepted exp-105 Space stack, and 2.0/2.5 ATR Space breakout stop variants across the three docs/backtesting.md fixed snapshots.
gate_questions.single_causal_variable: Only the Space breakout stop ATR multiple changes; target widths, risk scalars, entries, ranking, exits other than stop level, candidate pool, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay locked.

hypothesis: Official-catalyst Space breakout losses may be ordinary volatility shakeouts caused by the generic 1.5 ATR stop. A wider breakout stop could improve EV while the existing Space risk scalars keep notional bounded.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state forward data is still below the closed-decision gate; this run uses deterministic OHLCV stop-width replay.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not retry nearby Space breakout stop widths on the same frozen snapshots; future work needs forward replacement value or a genuinely new official catalyst-quality field.
rejection_reason: Wider official Space breakout stops did not beat the accepted exp-105 Space stack under the three-window gate. Space breakout fragility is not solved by simply giving breakouts more stop room.
single_causal_variable: initial stop ATR multiple for official-catalyst Space breakout_long signals inside the default-off Space sleeve
